stem:
Yusuf groups a metal spoon, a steel plate, and a copper coin as metals. He also talks about grouping by colour.

What common property is he using for the metals group?

options.text: Each metals group must hold only one object.
They share material properties of metals.
Any two metals alone would still make the group, even if the third object were left out.
Grouping by colour is the only correct grouping for these objects.

teacher.key_rationale: Classification uses a common property. Here the shared property is being metals.
